name: Priority Solar

about:
Priority Solar, LLC is based in Cheshire, Connecticut. The company was founded in 2006. Ownership details and founders are not publicly disclosed. The business began by listening to solar customers' challenges across the industry and refining its approach to deliver real solutions.

The firm provides residential solar photovoltaic installation, battery energy storage systems, roofing and site preparation, and financing options. It manages projects from initial savings analysis through installation, with customer testimonials citing approximately six weeks from consultation to system activation. No facility size or headcount figures are disclosed.

Priority Solar serves homeowners throughout Connecticut. Its clients include individuals seeking to reduce energy costs and achieve energy independence, as illustrated by testimonials from residents such as Ryan, Andre, and Rocco who highlight competitive pricing, roof replacement coordination, and personal owner involvement.

The company states its mission is to empower homeowners to embrace clean, sustainable energy through affordable options, urgent project management, and sensible solutions. It differentiates itself with a laid-back, supportive culture that it says fosters creativity and collaboration, and emphasizes being a local neighbor building stronger communities one energy-independent home at a time.
